model.name: unit.renameOverridesDerivedName
model.description: unit.rename(newName) sets the object's displayName (user override), which wins over derivedName; originalName preserved; uuid + links stable; renders live everywhere via the one view bus. Registered per class (no central switch).
model.note: class/method=null - architect wires on build-go (unit.rename per-class registration + displayName resolver). extends R40.99 naming.
